name: field-badges
description: Forty-four hand-drawn pin badges for memorable moments of real work (a rebase that went through, tests gone green, a workflow back home), each earned once ever and kept in a badge book beside the chat, with an original ladder of workshop titles. Looks only: it never changes what the model sees or does.

badges.title: Award badges
badges.description: Master switch. Off: nothing is recorded or drawn and /badges is not registered. Badges already earned stay in the mod's store.

toasts.title: Unlock toasts
toasts.description: A 5 s toast when a badge unlocks: at most one every 5 minutes, unlocks that arrive together merged into one.

pinDrops.title: Pin drops and title plaques
pinDrops.description: Desktop: a pin drops into the band above the prompt for 5 s when a badge unlocks, and a brass plaque shows a new workshop title for 8 s, at most once a day.

footerButton.title: Footer badge book icon
footerButton.description: Desktop: one small pressable badge icon at the right end of the prompt footer, after the other labels; pressing it opens the badge book. It takes the place of the footer count there.

footerIcon.title: Footer icon
footerIcon.description: The character the footer button shows, alone (no count, no words). A medal by default; for example ◆ for a quieter diamond.

footerLabel.title: Footer count
footerLabel.description: Terminal, and the Desktop when the footer icon is off: show the badge count as one footer label (a diamond and a number) once the first badge is earned.

command.title: /badges command
command.description: Register /badges, which opens the badge book. Its reply is empty, but the typed command line is kept in the conversation like any slash command.

hiddenHints.title: Hints for hidden badges
hiddenHints.description: Show hidden badges (and the Oddities) as grey silhouettes with their hint instead of a question mark.

oddities.title: Oddities chapter
oddities.description: Error flavours (ENOENT Eclair, Merge-Conflict Crumble and ten more), each discovered once ever. Refusals at the permission card never count.

kindledDays.title: Kindled Days chapter
kindledDays.description: Quietly records the days something shipped (a commit, a push, a pull request opened or merged), with best-run badges. No unlit state, no countdown, no reminder.

quiet.title: Quiet
quiet.description: No toasts, pin drops or plaques; badges are still earned, counted and kept in the book. The book's Hush button does the same without a reload.

workdays.title: Workdays
workdays.description: The days Clocked In counts and Kindled Days runs step over, as day names (Mon,Tue,Wed,Thu,Fri) or a range (Mon-Fri). A day off never breaks a run.

utcOffset.title: Clock offset
utcOffset.description: 'local' uses the clock the hooks see; a fixed offset such as +01:00 or -05:00 sets the day and time for the book's dates, workdays and Kindled Days.
